n1.speaker: dawson
n1.text: Hello again. Picking up George's repeat prescription?

translations.fa: دوباره سلام. نسخهٔ تکراری جورج را می‌برید؟

branches.suggestion: Yes please. It should be ready today.
branches.suggestionFa: آره لطفاً. باید امروز آماده باشه.

branches.suggestion: Yes. I've come on behalf of George Thompson.
branches.suggestionFa: آره. از طرف جورج تامپسون اومدم.

cultureNote.en: A "repeat prescription" is for regular medication — you order it without seeing the doctor each time.
cultureNote.fa: نسخهٔ تکراری برای داروهای منظم است.

n2.speaker: dawson
n2.text: Here we are — three items. Can you confirm his address?

translations.fa: بفرمایید — سه قلم. می‌تونید آدرسش را تأیید کنید؟

branches.suggestion: Of course. It's the same as mine.

n3.speaker: weda
n3.text: Hang on, love. There should be four items. Where's his water tablet?

translations.fa: صبر کن عزیزم. باید چهار قلم باشه. قرص ادرارآورش کجاست؟

branches.suggestion: I think there's been a mistake. One item is missing.
branches.suggestionFa: فکر کنم اشتباهی شده. یه قلم کمه.

branches.suggestion: Could you check again? We were expecting four.
branches.suggestionFa: می‌شه دوباره چک کنید؟ منتظر چهار تا بودیم.

match: there is a mistake one missing
recasts.echo: One item seems to be missing? Let me check.
recasts.better: I think one item is missing.

n4.speaker: dawson
n4.text: Let me look… Ah. The surgery only sent three. The furosemide wasn't on the request.

translations.fa: بذارید ببینم… آه. مطب فقط سه تا فرستاده. فوروسماید تو درخواست نبود.

branches.suggestion: But he takes it every day. What should we do?
branches.suggestionFa: ولی هر روز می‌خوره. چی کار کنیم؟

branches.suggestion: Is that a mistake by the surgery?

n5.speaker: weda
n5.text: He's got two days left. He mustn't run out — it's for his heart.

translations.fa: دو روز دیگه داره. نباید تموم بشه — برای قلبشه.

branches.suggestion: Can you contact the surgery for us?
branches.suggestionFa: می‌تونید از طرف ما با مطب تماس بگیرید؟

branches.suggestion: Is there an emergency supply you can give?
branches.suggestionFa: یه ذخیرهٔ اضطراری هست که بتونید بدید؟

n6.speaker: dawson
n6.text: I'll email the surgery now and mark it urgent. It's usually sorted within 48 hours.

translations.fa: الان به مطب ایمیل می‌زنم و فوریش علامت می‌زنم. معمولاً تا ۴۸ ساعت درست میشه.

branches.suggestion: And if it isn't ready in time?
Thank you. Should we call the surgery too?
branches.suggestionFa: ممنون. ما هم به مطب زنگ بزنیم؟

n7.speaker: dawson
n7.text: If it's not here by Thursday, I can give an emergency supply — a few days' worth. Bring his NHS number.

translations.fa: اگه تا پنجشنبه نرسید، می‌تونم یه ذخیرهٔ اضطراری بدم — به اندازهٔ چند روز. شمارهٔ NHS‌ش را بیارید.

branches.suggestion: That's a relief. Where do we find his NHS number?
branches.suggestionFa: خیالم راحت شد. شمارهٔ NHS‌ش را کجا پیدا کنیم؟

cultureNote.en: Pharmacists can give an emergency supply of regular medicines in many cases.

n8.speaker: dawson
n8.text: It's on his NHS app or any letter from the hospital. And use the app to order — it shows exactly what was requested.

translations.fa: تو اپ NHS‌ش هست یا هر نامه‌ای از بیمارستان. و از اپ برای سفارش استفاده کنید — دقیقاً نشون می‌ده چی درخواست شده.

branches.suggestion: We'll set up the app tonight.

branches.suggestionFa: به جورج کمک می‌کنم دانلودش کنه.

n9.speaker: weda
n9.text: Thank you, both. Forty years a nurse, and I still get caught out by paperwork! Come on, love — let's get him his tea.

translations.fa: ممنون، از هر دوتون. چهل سال پرستار بودم، و هنوز گیر کاغذبازی می‌افتم! بیا عزیزم — بریم چاییش را بدیم.
